title: Lobbying Explorer
subtitle: Browse Massachusetts lobbying disclosures filed with the Secretary of State.

banner.betaLine1: MAPLE's lobbying explorer is in beta. Please email

misc.viewOnSosLabel: View the original on the MA Secretary of State's website
misc.filesThroughFirm: {{name}} doesn't file lobbying disclosures directly; the entity that employs them reports this work. See its page for bills and clients.

explainers.statBills: Bills that have been the subject of at least one lobbying disclosure.
explainers.statClients: Organizations that have hired lobbyists to advocate on their behalf.
explainers.statLobbyists: People registered as individual lobbyists with the MA Secretary of State, each counted once. Before 2019, lobbyists employed by a firm registered under the firm and aren't counted here.
explainers.statSpend: Sum of all annual compensation amounts reported by lobbyists to the Secretary of State.
explainers.bills: Bills that appear in lobbying disclosures filed with the MA Secretary of State, across all sessions in this dataset.
explainers.clients: Organizations that retained lobbyists or lobbied on their own behalf, as reported in annual compensation disclosures.
explainers.firms: Individual lobbyists and lobbyist entities (firms and organizations that employ lobbyists) registered with the MA Secretary of State.
explainers.spendNotReported: Spending isn't shown for {{years}}: disclosures from those years don't report compensation by client.

attribution: Data from the MA Secretary of State Lobbyist Public Search.
